name: SD: a managed fishery (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A fishing port's weekly records over ten years: the survey's estimates of juvenile and adult fish, the boats in port and at sea, the fish landed on the quay, and the fish the plant has processed. The data is generated by a system dynamics model of the fishery (the ground truth is in sd-fishery/truth.model.json, including a stock the records do not show), so discovery can be checked exactly. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
